source: E5/Logo.e5 (Ls12, 40 entries; loaders call 0x448a0b(entry, buf) / 0x4789d6 with the archive opened by 0x4165b8 ("E5\\LOGO.E5")); JPEG entries copied unchanged as NN.jpg, BMP entries keyed (247,0,255) RGBA NN.png
title: screens/00 + emblems 01..03 (no alternative title pictures as in wg2025 GHAI 13..15)

title emblem (blue bird) 64x64 at (388,340) when 0x41a280(2)
